observations.source_title: Hasil Pencarian - KBBI VI Daring: bus
observations.publisher: Badan Pengembangan dan Pembinaan Bahasa, Kementerian Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah Republik Indonesia
observations.observation: Entry bus¹ defines it as a large public motor vehicle capable of carrying many passengers. It does not make a route part of the definition.
observations.limitations: Dictionary definition supports the sense and its breadth, not actual frequency or everyday usage.

observations.source_title: Hasil Pencarian - KBBI VI Daring: bus
observations.publisher: Badan Pengembangan dan Pembinaan Bahasa, Kementerian Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah Republik Indonesia
observations.observation: The entry labels bis as a nonstandard form of bus. This supports the standard-status contrast; it does not establish everyday preference independently.
observations.limitations: The entry establishes normative status, not comparative corpus frequency or colloquial prevalence.

observations.source_group: DBP PRPM, Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat and Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua
observations.observation: The retrieved DBP result defines bas as a large vehicle carrying passengers that usually operates according to a set schedule. Another listed dictionary entry describes a motorized, long vehicle carrying many passengers.
observations.page_location_or_query: Search result for bas; Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat and Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua entries
observations.register: Standard Malay; the sense is general
observations.limitations: Supports the recorded sense, but does not independently establish contemporary frequency or preference.

observations.source_group: DBP PRPM, Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat and Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua

observations.page_location_or_query: Search result for bas; dictionary definition
observations.limitations: A dictionary listing establishes the word and sense, not comparative everyday preference.

observations.source_group: DBP PRPM, Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat and Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua
observations.observation: Kamus Dewan defines teksi as a hired car carrying passengers and records a colloquial sense of a three-wheeled beca in Kelantan. Kamus Pelajar gives the hired-car sense.
observations.page_location_or_query: Search result for teksi; dictionary definitions and usage note
observations.register: General Malay; the Kelantan sense is marked colloquial
observations.limitations: The dictionary supports the recorded senses, not the prevalence or currentness of either sense.

observations.source_group: DBP PRPM, Kamus Dewan Edisi Keempat and Kamus Pelajar Edisi Kedua
observations.observation: The DBP entry records teksi for the conventional hired-car sense. It does not compare it with alternatives or establish present-day everyday preference.
observations.page_location_or_query: Search result for teksi; Kamus Dewan and Kamus Pelajar definitions
observations.limitations: A dictionary listing supports existence and sense, not normal contemporary preference.

observations.source_title: Lema Ban - Tesaurus Tematis Bahasa Indonesia
observations.publisher: Kementerian Pendidikan Dasar dan Menengah Republik Indonesia
observations.observation: The thesaurus lists ban in its transport-related thematic classification, including under TRANSPORTASI DARAT. It makes no comparison with alternatives or claim about everyday frequency.
observations.limitations: Thematic inclusion supports domain association, not contemporary preference.
